Speaker: Journal
Text: Travel to Morthal and speak with Hakan Reed-Walker.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: queststart; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Veyra asked you to investigate Hrefna Stormhollow. Hakan, who found Eirik Ashmark's body, was your first lead.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: queststart; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Investigate the Stormhollow farm and its cellar.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: farm; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hakan linked Eirik to the seized farm and warned you about Quintus, a supposed trader asking about Hrefna's visitors.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: farm; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Find Hrefna at the hunting camp.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: camp; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: The cellar held traces of a Black Sacrament. You followed the trail toward Hrefna's hunting camp.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: camp; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hear Hrefna's account of Eirik's death.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: accusation; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hrefna confronted you at the camp. Once she learned who you were, she demanded to know why no one had come.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: accusation; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hear Veyra's proposed trial before deciding.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: veyra_arrives; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hrefna admitted drowning Eirik. She said Quintus was watching for whoever answered her prayer.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: veyra_arrives; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Confront Quintus with Hrefna.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: authorized=true; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: You authorized the task against Quintus. Hrefna agreed to accompany you, but her admission to the family remained undecided.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: authorized=true; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Search Quintus's belongings.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: killer=hrefna; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hrefna killed Quintus. His papers could explain the purpose of his investigation.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: killer=hrefna; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Examine the papers Quintus carried.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: killer=player; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: You killed Quintus yourself. Hrefna's ability to complete the task remained unproven.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: killer=player; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Decide whether Hrefna belongs in the Brotherhood.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: judgment; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Quintus was dead. You still had to decide whether to admit Hrefna, release her, or silence her.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: judgment; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Report Hrefna's recruitment to Veyra.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=recruited; killer=hrefna; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hrefna accepted a place in Dawnstar after killing Quintus herself. Her work in the family had yet to begin.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=recruited; killer=hrefna; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Tell Veyra why you admitted Hrefna despite her unfinished trial.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=recruited; killer=player; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: You completed the killing and admitted Hrefna. She accepted without claiming your deed as her own.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=recruited; killer=player; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Tell Veyra you released Hrefna.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=released; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: You let Hrefna leave after Quintus's death. She had no further obligation to the Brotherhood beyond keeping your meeting secret.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=released; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Report Hrefna's death to Veyra.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=dead; hrefnaDead=true; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: You chose to silence Hrefna, and her death was confirmed. There would be no recruit from this investigation.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: outcome=dead; hrefnaDead=true; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Discuss the Oculatus dispatch with Veyra.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: fragment=true; kein neuer Quest-Stage.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Quintus's documents identified the Penitus Oculatus and a wider interest in Black Sacrament activity. They did not identify who directed the reports.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur Teilphase/Bedingung: fragment=true; kein neuer Quest-Stage.
